facts.text: I am asking about incorporating diverse perspectives and demographics in the idea generation process.
I am questioning why the focus is solely on gender diversity.
I am asking why racial and ethnic diversity should not also be included.
I am asking whether it is really necessary to focus so much on diversity in hiring.
I am asking whether hiring should be based on the most qualified candidates regardless of background.
I am describing that, as a hiring manager, it can be challenging to navigate biases and systemic barriers when incorporating diverse candidates into the hiring process.
I am asking what steps can be taken to overcome biases and systemic barriers and create a more inclusive workplace.
